authority: Navigation over existing EDA scientific reference and plotting cards. Existing Rules and their exceptions remain unchanged. This is not execution authorization.
workflow: Select a relevant question, declare required preparation, map to a supported display, then finalize display once after EC. Do not run every method.

methods.name: Concentration-time observations
methods.question: Inspect observed shape and sampling coverage.
methods.required_context: Recorded time origin, concentration basis, units and series identity.
methods.ec_preparation: Source-native points; documented unit/time conversion only if needed and implemented.
methods.post_ec_decision: Retain points when individual linkage is absent; choose a log axis only when useful.
methods.execution_status: PLANNING_GUIDANCE; require the current explicit operation registry.

methods.name: Experimental-unit-aware summaries
methods.question: Determine which observations can be summarized or connected.
methods.required_context: Individual, destructive, pooled, technical-repeat or summary level.
methods.ec_preparation: Verified grouping and descriptive summaries only with an implemented operation.
methods.post_ec_decision: Do not turn means into individuals; label biological versus technical n.
methods.execution_status: PLANNING_GUIDANCE; require the current explicit operation registry.

methods.name: Observation availability and censoring
methods.question: Locate missing, unavailable and censored measurements.
methods.required_context: Recorded status codes, known limits and supported sampling schedule.
methods.ec_preparation: Status counts and layout; never fill missing values.
methods.post_ec_decision: Unknown limits use a status view, not invented coordinates.
methods.execution_status: PLANNING_GUIDANCE; require the current explicit operation registry.

methods.name: Exposure windows and late observations
methods.question: Show which requested windows are observed.
methods.required_context: Requested time window, actual samples and input-event history.
methods.ec_preparation: Supported time alignment; no AUC or terminal-slope calculation.
methods.post_ec_decision: Annotate gaps and unobserved tails; do not draw extrapolated trajectories.
methods.execution_status: PLANNING_GUIDANCE; require the current explicit operation registry.

methods.name: Dose-level comparison
methods.question: Compare measured responses across documented doses.
methods.required_context: Compatible dose basis, units, regimen and data level.
methods.ec_preparation: Dose normalization only with supported nonzero dose and implemented arithmetic.
methods.post_ec_decision: Use separate native-dose panels when normalization is unsupported; no dose-proportionality claim.
methods.execution_status: PLANNING_GUIDANCE; require the current explicit operation registry.

methods.name: Repeated dosing and input history
methods.question: Relate observations to documented dose events.
methods.required_context: Dose times, interval, route, duration and actual/nominal distinction.
methods.ec_preparation: Documented time alignment only; no inferred steady state or accumulation estimate.
methods.post_ec_decision: Preserve dosing events and alternative unresolved time origins.
methods.execution_status: PLANNING_GUIDANCE; require the current explicit operation registry.

methods.name: Longitudinal PD and time-kill
methods.question: Describe observed response changes and controls.
methods.required_context: Response definition, time, group, detection status and verified identity.
methods.ec_preparation: Established transformations only when supported and implemented.
methods.post_ec_decision: Already-log10 responses stay on their reported scale; no second log transform.
methods.execution_status: PLANNING_GUIDANCE; require the current explicit operation registry.

methods.name: Fixed-endpoint PD
methods.question: Compare observed endpoint effects with the requested effect.
methods.required_context: Endpoint, baseline/control, group and uncertainty definitions.
methods.ec_preparation: Supported endpoint-minus-baseline calculation only if implemented; no invented pairing.
methods.post_ec_decision: Keep reported responses when a baseline contrast cannot be established.
methods.execution_status: PLANNING_GUIDANCE; require the current explicit operation registry.

methods.name: Dose fractionation and regimen design
methods.question: Show total dose, frequency and schedule differences.
methods.required_context: Documented regimen, dose basis and experiment groups.
methods.ec_preparation: Supported event layout; any arithmetic needs an implementation.
methods.post_ec_decision: Display design differences without selecting a PK/PD index.
methods.execution_status: PLANNING_GUIDANCE; require the current explicit operation registry.

methods.name: Existing exposure/index-response
methods.question: Describe linked existing index and response values.
methods.required_context: Matched experimental scope, concentration basis, window and MIC where relevant.
methods.ec_preparation: Permitted quotient of existing inputs only; no new exposure integration or fitting.
methods.post_ec_decision: If linkage fails, show evidence separately rather than inventing matched pairs.
methods.execution_status: PLANNING_GUIDANCE; require the current explicit operation registry.

methods.name: Cross-experiment PK-PD correspondence
methods.question: Show which PK and PD evidence can be related.
methods.required_context: Source experiments, species, regimen and documented linkage.
methods.ec_preparation: Source correspondence layout only; no inferred joins.
methods.post_ec_decision: Keep unresolved links visible and avoid presenting independent records as matched observations.
methods.execution_status: PLANNING_GUIDANCE; require the current explicit operation registry.

methods.name: Multiple matrices or analytes
methods.question: Inspect source-defined differences across compartments of observation.
methods.required_context: Matrix, analyte, total/free basis and units.
methods.ec_preparation: Separate native series; no unsupported basis conversion.
methods.post_ec_decision: Use distinct panels when values are not directly comparable.
methods.execution_status: PLANNING_GUIDANCE; require the current explicit operation registry.

methods.name: Binding and measured unbound concentration
methods.question: Describe relevant binding or directly measured free-concentration evidence.
methods.required_context: Species, assay conditions, binding definition and total/free pairing.
methods.ec_preparation: Only established conversions or supplied values; no species transfer assumptions.
methods.post_ec_decision: Unknown binding relations remain explicit; raw evidence can still be displayed.
methods.execution_status: PLANNING_GUIDANCE; require the current explicit operation registry.

methods.name: Stability and urinary evidence
methods.question: Describe optional stability or observed collection evidence.
methods.required_context: Matrix, reference amount, collection intervals and completeness.
methods.ec_preparation: Supported descriptive ratios/totals only with complete inputs and implemented operations.
methods.post_ec_decision: Do not assume missing collections are zero or select a clearance model.
methods.execution_status: PLANNING_GUIDANCE; require the current explicit operation registry.

methods.name: Matched MIC and MIC distributions
methods.question: Inspect strain matches, bins and population frequencies.
methods.required_context: Strain identity, MIC units, exact bins/counts and denominator.
methods.ec_preparation: Documented counts/proportions; no invented open-bin midpoint.
methods.post_ec_decision: Retain incomplete totals and censoring; do not imply valid PTA weights.
methods.execution_status: PLANNING_GUIDANCE; require the current explicit operation registry.

methods.name: General descriptive summaries
methods.question: Summarize verified comparable observations.
methods.required_context: Observation unit, grouping, units, status and denominator.
methods.ec_preparation: Count, mean/median, SD, range or quantiles only when applicable and implemented.
methods.post_ec_decision: Keep unavailable SD unknown; do not reconstruct raw distributions from summaries.
methods.execution_status: PLANNING_GUIDANCE; require the current explicit operation registry.

methods.name: Distribution exploration
methods.question: Explore observed spread, asymmetry and distribution shape.
methods.required_context: Raw comparable values with source and unit identities.
methods.ec_preparation: Explicit histogram bins, ECDF or density settings; no silent renderer statistics.
methods.post_ec_decision: Prefer points for sparse groups; no automatic outlier deletion or normality verdict.
methods.execution_status: PLANNING_GUIDANCE; require the current explicit operation registry.

methods.name: Paired observations and changes
methods.question: Describe changes within established pairs.
methods.required_context: Verified pair key, comparable endpoints, units and reference.
methods.ec_preparation: Supported differences only; no pairing by row order.
methods.post_ec_decision: Unpaired evidence uses separate group displays; do not invent paired effects.
methods.execution_status: PLANNING_GUIDANCE; require the current explicit operation registry.

methods.name: Multivariable descriptive views
methods.question: Inspect jointly observed quantities relevant to an allowed question.
methods.required_context: Verified common observational unit and variable meanings.
methods.ec_preparation: Source pairing/layout only; no automatic correlation testing, clustering or regression.
methods.post_ec_decision: Respect the current exclusion of covariate analysis; graphics do not expand scope.
methods.execution_status: PLANNING_GUIDANCE; require the current explicit operation registry.

methods.name: Category composition
methods.question: Show source category frequencies and proportions.
methods.required_context: Defined categories, count unit, denominator and missing categories.
methods.ec_preparation: Supported counts/proportions only.
methods.post_ec_decision: No silent renormalization of incomplete totals; label records versus subjects.
methods.execution_status: PLANNING_GUIDANCE; require the current explicit operation registry.

methods.name: Study-design and data-status overview
methods.question: Show what was observed and when.
methods.required_context: Source events, sample status and source-defined experimental units.
methods.ec_preparation: Documented status/event layout and counts.
methods.post_ec_decision: Distinguish scheduled from actual events; no repeated Data adequacy assessment.
methods.execution_status: PLANNING_GUIDANCE; require the current explicit operation registry.
